personality_one_liner: A deeply human, emotionally resonant storytelling experience that feels like a reflective journal rather than a clinical calculator.

spacing.rule: Generous, soft flowing layouts. Let whitespace breathe like margins in a notebook. Avoid dense, cramped dashboard-style groupings.

do's: Skip glass entirely as it clashes with the paper-like, hand-drawn aesthetic.
dont's: Do not use blur or frosted glass. Rely on soft tints, paper textures, and gentle gradients instead.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Sets an emotional hook right away using warm family photography and narrative-led copy before jumping into the app.

states.loading: Centered soft spinner on a warm off-white background.
states.error: Readable message on surfaceSecondary + Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery of a warm family home lifestyle. Ensure the image has a vertical gradient-to-dark scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) starting at 50% so that the overlaid Fraunces text and the primary CTA are perfectly readable.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Provides entry into the app, saving their progress.

states.error: Soft red warning message + Retry button.

screens.layout: Clean, soft, single-column paper-like layout. Inputs use surfaceTertiary background with no borders. Submit button sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Assessment Questionnaire
screens.purpose: Gathers details about family, income, and debts iteratively without overwhelming the user.

states.error: Error message with soft retry button.

screens.layout: Conditional branching: display one question per screen. A soft progression bar sits at the top. Use large touch targets (pills/cards) for answers instead of small radio buttons. The 'Continue' CTA is sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Your Family's Story (Report)
screens.purpose: Translates numbers into emotional real-world impacts, showing a timeline of when money runs out.

states.loading: Generating your story... with a soft fading animation.
states.error: Failed to generate report. Retry button.

screens.layout: A hybrid narrative timeline. Start with a headline insight (e.g., 'Your family is protected for 3 years, but...'). Follow with a vertical timeline rail showing real family milestones (e.g., Kids' Uni, Mortgage) plotted against a fading 'Savings Runway'. The AI narrative should be styled like a softly highlighted paper card. End with breakdown cards (Life, Income, Critical Illness) in surfaceSecondary.

screens.name: Learn
screens.purpose: An educational archive explaining insurance concepts simply.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty notebook page with 'No articles found'.

screens.layout: Editorial layout with generous vertical spacing. Use full-width sections and quiet dividers. Large Fraunces titles for article cards, with short Quicksand excerpts.

screens.name: Talk to an Adviser
screens.purpose: Connects users with a human adviser via a lead form and a Calendly scheduling link.
screens.layout: Profile photo of the friendly adviser at the top in a circle or soft-corner rectangle. Humanized contact form on a surfaceSecondary card, followed by a 'Book a call' sticky primary button.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Houses saved assessments and account settings.

states.empty: Illustration of a closed folder + 'No saved assessments yet'.

screens.layout: List items with leading icons inside brandTertiary tinted rounded squares. Minimum 56pt tappable height. Clear log-out button.

onboarding_hero.alt: A happy family running together in a sunlit garden

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the earthy, hand-drawn color palette: soft creams, sage green, clay, and charcoal text. NO purples, NO blues, NO pure blacks.
The typography is a critical part of the UI. Use 'Fraunces' for editorial, emotional headings and 'Quicksand' for soft, legible body text. Do not exceed font-weight 500 for any text.
Do not use blur or glassmorphism. It clashes with the 'Hand-drawn / Journal' personality. Use soft tints (surfaceSecondary, surfaceTertiary) instead of shadows or glass.
For the multi-step Gap Assessment Questionnaire, present ONE question per screen. Do not bundle all questions into a single long scrolling form. Provide a soft progress bar.

The 'Your Family's Story' report MUST be a hybrid narrative timeline layout. It should visually plot the 'savings runway' (money running out in month X) against life milestones, rather than just spitting out a raw number.
Any text overlaid on full-bleed images (like Onboarding) MUST use a vertical gradient-to-dark scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to ensure text readability.
